description: a child may call only the tools listed when it was created
a child's view outlives a reload
a child may call a server's tool before its list loads
A child's `fx mcp call` skips the integrations check: a tool whose list was not loaded when its command began runs
old:
/\ IF t[1] \in shell.snap
       THEN LET lists

description: A child's refused `fx mcp call` is checked after the server's list is asked for: it starts a server to load it
new:
ELSE /\ loaded' = IF t[1] \in usable THEN loaded \cup {t[1]} ELSE loaded
            /\ startedByRefusal' = (startedByRefusal \/ (t[1] \in usable /\ t[1] \notin loaded))
            /\ UNCHANGED ran
